title: Molecular structure of polysaccharide mediated autophagy markers KIF23 and PRC1 proteins and their regulatory role in triple negative cancer through the p53 signaling pathway.
authors: Wang, Xiaoxiao; Wang, Wei; Zeng, Hanling; Hu, Xinru; Chen, Fangyi; Shen, Li; Tao, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究KIF23/PRC1蛋白与多糖互作及在乳腺癌中经p53通路调控自噬，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且方法以湿实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: As a process of intracellular degradation and recycling of its own components, abnormal regulation of autophagy has been strongly associated with the development of multiple cancer types, including triple-negative breast cancer. The amino acid sequences of KIF23 and PRC1 proteins were analyzed by bioinformatics method, their three-dimensional structures were predicted, and their interactions with polysaccharides were studied by molecular docking technology. The localization and expression patterns of KIF23 and PRC1 in cells were studied by cell biology techniques. By constructing breast cancer cell lines that stably overexpress or knock down KIF23 and PRC1, we evaluated the effect of these proteins on autophagy activity. Finally, molecular biological methods such as Western blot and real-time quantitative PCR were used to detect the expression changes of proteins related to p53 signaling pathway and the levels of autophagy markers such as LC3 and p62, thereby revealing the regulatory effects of KIF23 and PRC1 on autophagy of triple-negative breast cancer cells through p53 signaling pathway. The study found that the KIF23 and PRC1 proteins have complex three-dimensional structures, and their interactions with polysaccharides may affect their function during cell division and autophagy. In triple-negative breast cancer cells, overexpression of KIF23 and PRC1 significantly enhanced autophagy activity, while knockdown of these proteins inhibited autophagy. Further experiments showed that KIF23 and PRC1 regulate the expression of autophagy related proteins by influencing the activity of p53 signaling pathway. Overexpression of KIF23 and PRC1 led to inhibition of the p53 signaling pathway, while knocking down these proteins activated the p53 signaling pathway, which was consistent with reduced autophagy activity.
abstract_zh: 作为细胞内降解和回收自身组分的过程，自噬的异常调控与多种癌症类型（包括三阴性乳腺癌）的发生密切相关。通过生物信息学方法分析KIF23和PRC1蛋白的氨基酸序列，预测其三维结构，并利用分子对接技术研究它们与多糖的相互作用。采用细胞生物学技术研究KIF23和PRC1在细胞中的定位和表达模式。通过构建稳定过表达或敲低KIF23和PRC1的乳腺癌细胞系，评估这些蛋白对自噬活性的影响。最后，利用Western blot和实时定量PCR等分子生物学方法检测p53信号通路相关蛋白的表达变化以及LC3和p62等自噬标志物的水平，从而揭示KIF23和PRC1通过p53信号通路对三阴性乳腺癌细胞自噬的调控作用。研究发现，KIF23和PRC1蛋白具有复杂的三维结构，它们与多糖的相互作用可能影响其在细胞分裂和自噬过程中的功能。在三阴性乳腺癌细胞中，过表达KIF23和PRC1显著增强自噬活性，而敲低这些蛋白则抑制自噬。进一步实验表明，KIF23和PRC1通过影响p53信号通路的活性来调控自噬相关蛋白的表达。过表达KIF23和PRC1导致p53信号通路受到抑制，而敲低这些蛋白则激活p53信号通路，这与自噬活性降低相一致。
